text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The sterile, modern design of the meeting room invites contemplation, as if ideas are waiting quietly in the charged silence. Stepping further, the vibrant wall of the R+D display energizes me—its bold typography, interactive screens, and colors inspire a sense of progress and youthful potential. I am reminded of the ever-evolving relationship between people and technology, and I feel both excited and reflective about what new collaborations might arise in spaces like these.
